description: Linear Gauge by Powerviz is an intuitive visual to track the progress against the Targets in a Horizontal/Vertical scale with many preset Templates to choose from. A Linear gauge is an advanced visual that is commonly used to display the progress against set targets on a linear scale, with an axis displaying a range of values or percentages. The Linear Gauge quickly conveys the current status or progress of a task or value being measured. It is regularly used for project management, performance tracking, and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs). Check out the live demo here. To access all advanced settings features, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner. Key Feature Highlights: Gauge Style - Choose from a various Gauge styles like linear, bar-in-bar, cylinder, and thermometer with both vertical and Horizontal orientation. It also comes with additional options to customize the gauge radius, orientation, and more. Templates - Use the well crafted Gauge Templates to easily get started and customize it later as needed. Scale - Choose the scale to be either absolute or percentage number format, including an option to customize min-max range with various formatting choices.
